description: This file defines an interface for an in-memory stream queue grain in Orleans, including methods for enqueuing and dequeuing messages.

classes.name: IMemoryStreamQueueGrain
classes.description: Interface for in-memory stream queue grain, providing methods to enqueue and dequeue messages.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a memory message data into the stream queue.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Dequeues up to maxCount memory message data items from the stream queue.
